remarks: Come & Visit our Picture Perfect Exquisite One Bedroom w/Full Bath upper level unit at Hayes House. Entry Foyer has Two Large Closets, Rectangular Shaped Living Room w/beautifully refreshed wooden floors, newer windows, electronically controlled window blinds, sliders to Balcony. Separate Dining Room Area. Exquisitely Renovated Kitchen with new flooring, elegant cabinetry, quartz counter-tops & Stainless-Steel appliances. The Kitchen also has a large Pantry plus an additional closet. Over-sized Primary Bedroom with custom designed blackout window blinds. Fully renovated custom Bathroom by Kohler (with Lux Stone walls), Large Stall Shower, New Commode, New Vanity. There are California Closets throughout the unit. Laundry Facilities are on C Level, State of the Art Health & Fitness Center ($15. per month per person). One indoor parking garage space. Additional indoor and outdoor parking available at a monthly charge. Community Room (for interior entertaining & meetings). Over-sized exterior deck for warm weather entertaining. Heat/Hot Water & Central AC included in monthly Common Charges. Walk to town center for great restaurants/movies/library. 24 Hour Door Person Building. Seven minutes to Stamford RR Station & I 95. This is an extraordinary opportunity to own a unit that sparkles.
